method: 4096-point Hann STFT, 2048 hop; stereo summed power, RMS after existing role gain
policy: Only non-anchor support with band overlap >.75 and relative RMS >-8dB receives modest linked attenuation, 250ms ramps. No global or corrective EQ.
limitation: Band overlap and coactivity indicate potential competition, not a measured psychoacoustic masking threshold. Musical usefulness requires listening.
temporal_method: 100ms stereo RMS bins, active >= own-role preview peak RMS minus 30dB; coactivity measured relative to featured active bins. Correlation and activity are diagnostic, not proof of masking.
full_song_section_method: Inherited tentative T001 section map; same STFT bands plus 100ms coactivity; report pairs only when overlap >.75, coactive union fraction >.25 and RMS difference <12dB. Activity floor -70dBFS. No full-song audio processed or exported.
